London hotel prices: median $277 a night with taxes and fees, 17 hotels priced Sep 25, 2026

These prices were read on September 25, 2026 for a stay of Oct 30 to Nov 1, 2026, which has passed. Check today's price for your dates

London's median: $277 a night all-in, at 14 hotels for 2 adults, from $106 at Royal London Hotel to $652 at The Langham, London.

Check a London hotel for your dates or check any hotel's price

Google Hotels returned these 17 London hotels, on 56 booking sites; London's median was the 4th highest of the 25 cities priced that day. Listed prices only: Smart Hyde Park View, Lost Property St Paul's London - Curio Collection by Hilton and Rosewood London.

By their names, 4 of the 17 name Blackfriars, St Paul's, Southwark or the City and 3 name Hyde Park, Victoria or Whitehall. Airports of London: Heathrow (LHR), Gatwick (LGW), Stansted (STN), Luton (LTN) and London City (LCY). The local currency is the pound sterling (GBP); the prices here are in US dollars, as a US visitor saw them.

The booking sites at London hotels

56 sites, 12 of them at one hotel only. Most hotels listed: Booking.com at 16, Priceline at 16, Vio.com at 16, dealbase.com at 15, Etrip.net at 15 and Hotels.com at 15. Fewest sites: Royal London Hotel (7); most: The Tower Hotel, by Thistle (28, as were 5 others).

Booking.com was lowest at Royal London Hotel and Smart Hyde Park View of its 16, and 5%+ above another site at 13. Priceline was lowest at Royal London Hotel of its 16, and 5%+ above another site at 14. Vio.com was lowest at Royal London Hotel and The Langham, London of its 16, and 5%+ above another site at 11.

The hotel's own site, at 12 of the 17: lowest at none, a median 20% above the lowest site. Nearest: Lost Property St Paul's London - Curio Collection by Hilton, $243 against $242 on Qantas Hotels. Farthest: The Royal Horseguards Hotel & One Whitehall Place, London, $416 against $285 on Super.com.

Lowest at 5%+ below the going rate: Super.com at 10, Booking.com at 1, Etrip.net at 1, goseek.com at 1, Kiwi.com at 1, klook at 1, Traveluro at 1 and Vio.com at 1 (ties count for each). All cities: which booking site was lowest most often.

Google's free cancellation label was on a site's lowest listing at 8 of the 17, on the lowest price at 0; at the other 8 it cost a median $67 (34%) more. Is it worth it?

A lower price may be a smaller room or a non-refundable rate. Up to 28 listings were kept per hotel.

Taxes and fees in London

They added a median of 20.0% ($46 a night) to the before-tax going rate. It was 19.8% to 20.5% at all 14 hotels, from Royal London Hotel to The Langham, London: no flat nightly fee on top. Whether a resort fee was inside the before-tax price, our data cannot tell. The 3 listed prices may leave out resort or property fees. More: hotel booking fees explained.

London, priced again a week later

Same stay, same London hotels, 7 days apart, before tax; up and down mean more than 2%. Each stay links its CSV.

  • Oct 13 to Oct 15 stay, Sep 22 then Sep 29: 4 up, 0 down of 4; rose most Kimpton Fitzroy London, $546 to $715; another site lowest at 2.
  • Oct 30 to Nov 1 stay, Sep 25 then Oct 2: 11 up, 4 down of 17; rose most Royal London Hotel, $88 to $147; fell most Smart Hyde Park View, $186 to $151; another site lowest at 8.

One week is no rule for when to book.

Questions about London hotel prices

How much is a hotel in London?

$277 a night all-in at the median (Sep 25, 2026 prices), from $106 at Royal London Hotel to $652 at The Langham, London.

Does our data show the cheapest time to book a hotel in London?

No: these prices come from a few London dates, not a season. Sep 25 to Oct 2: 11 London hotels rose more than 2%, 4 fell; Royal London Hotel rose most, $88 to $147 before tax.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for London hotels?

Below the going rate, most often Super.com (10 hotels). The hotel's own site: lowest at none of 12.

How we measured this

The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price). The study's method. Words last changed November 23, 2026; prices read September 25, 2026; each hotel's page has every site's price in the newest snapshot that priced it.

Nearest medians to London's: Chicago $276, Nashville $290, Los Angeles $303, Cancun $233.
